summary: Seal forest-raw endpoint: default RF 1000 trees, preregistered rep-10-fold cv, score heldout once, write flat trio
reasoning: Milestone forest-raw-cv is refuted on pilot evidence: the best honest configuration (default RandomForest, 1000 trees, pre-registered repeated 10-fold x 5 repeats, seed 0) gives cv_auc 0.7878 (se ~0.0066); seeds moved the rep5x5 mean only ±0.005 (0.7826/0.7871/0.7891), 500 to 1000 trees +0.001, so no in-route dial reaches 0.80. This final run seals the route's endpoint: analysis.py's protocol is fixed to the preregistered repeated 10-fold chosen for fit-size reasons (not to game the estimate), tree count 1000 chosen by pilot CV mean, and --final reads data/heldout.csv exactly once, writing the flat trio cv_auc, holdout_auc, gap. The final model is fitted on all 1000 pilot rows; the 10-fold CV (900-row folds) should if anything slightly understate it, so my prediction is holdout near 0.79, below the 0.80 floor, with the gap well inside ±0.05 since pilot and held-out are fresh draws of the same generator. Baseline machinery already reproduced (0.6330 vs established 0.6313, probe:synth-r1-pairs#step-9). If holdout unexpectedly clears 0.80 with the gap inside tolerance, milestone 2's letter is met even though cv < 0.80, and I will report that precisely.
